morphology.pattern_note: 输入包将整词误标为词根；按 DBP 的 detak 词条校正为 ber- + detak。词根不变，马来西亚标准语词末 k 通常实现为喉塞音 [ʔ]。[DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=detak)

senses.zh_definition: 发出像心脏搏动一样的声音；怦怦跳动。
senses.en_definition: To beat or throb with a sound like a heartbeat.
senses.nuances: 不及物动词，常以 jantung 为主语，突出搏动及其可感知的声响。berdenyut 更广泛地表达脉动；berdebar 常突出紧张或激动时的心跳。[DBP 释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=detak)

senses.zh_definition: 某种念头或感受在心中萌生、浮现或暗自蕴藏。
senses.en_definition: Of a thought or feeling, to arise or remain unexpressed within someone.
senses.ms_definition: Secara kiasan, terfikir, terasa atau terpendam dalam hati.
senses.nuances: 文学性比喻，常与 hati 连用；不表示心脏实际发声。日常交流通常改说 terlintas dalam fikiran 或 terasa dalam hati。[DBP 比喻义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=detak)

collocations.en: to arise in his or her heart

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Dalam temu bual selepas pertandingan, atlet itu mengakui bahawa jantungnya berdetak kencang ketika menunggu keputusan rasmi.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该运动员在赛后采访中坦言，等待正式成绩时，他的心怦怦直跳。
dual_scenarios.en: In a post-competition interview, the athlete admitted that his heart was pounding while he waited for the official results.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Jantung aku berdetak laju gila tadi, weh!
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Jantung saya berdetak sangat laju tadi!
dual_scenarios.zh: 我刚才心跳快得不得了！
dual_scenarios.en: My heart was racing just now!
spoken_features: laju gila 是熟人聊天中的夸张程度表达。
weh 是引起朋友注意或加强情绪的口语呼语。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Jantung aku berdetak laju gila tadi, weh! Nama aku tiba-tiba kena panggil.
messages.ms_standard: Jantung saya berdetak sangat laju tadi! Nama saya tiba-tiba dipanggil.
messages.zh: 我刚才心跳快得不得了！他们突然叫到我的名字。
messages.en: My heart was racing just now! They suddenly called my name.

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah habis dah pembentangan tu. Jom, aku nak belanja kau minum.
messages.ms_standard: Pembentangan itu sudah selesai. Mari, saya hendak membelanja kamu minum.
messages.zh: 汇报都结束啦。走，我请你喝点东西。
messages.en: The presentation's over now. Come on, let me buy you a drink.

etymology.historical_story: Berdetak is built from detak, the noun for a heartbeat-like sound, with the prefix ber-. Its sound-centered meaning makes the heartbeat especially vivid. Dewan also records a figurative extension: thoughts or feelings can berdetak within the heart, connecting bodily rhythm with the inner life of a character in literary expression. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=detak)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 de-tak 听成“哒、哒”的心跳声；加 ber-，就是“正在发出这种跳动声”。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 词本身中性。谈自己紧张时可自然使用；正式交流中避免搭配 laju gila、weh 等熟人口语。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合叙述心跳、紧张和激动；心中念头的比喻义适合小说与抒情文字。与长辈或上级交谈时，通常采用 saya 和完整句式。
